title: Computational protocol to identify shared transcriptional risks and compounds between diseases
author: Gao, Zhang, et al.
materials: Affymetrix Human Genome U133 Plus 2.0 Array

steps.title: Identify shared transcriptional risks
steps.instruction: Use The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) datasets for the various cancer subtypes together with the Stockholm‑Tartu Atherosclerosis Reverse Network Engineering Task (STARNET) and Biobank of Karolinska Endarterectomy (BiKE) atherosclerosis datasets to identify transcriptional risks that are shared between cancer and atherosclerosis; the workflow can be adapted to any analogous datasets that provide summary statistics of transcriptional risks.

steps.title: Set up computing environment
steps.instruction: Follow the recommendations for hardware specifications, localize the analysis pipeline, configure the computing environment, and download any restricted resources required for the workflow as outlined in the ‘Before you begin’ section.
